notes: Parses one animation frame's raw per-label transform payload. For each of `animFrameDef.anIntArray6957[label]` group-type codes (the same 0/1/2/3/5/7/8/9/10 type values switched on in AbstractModel.method605/I()/P() - avg-centroid/translate/rotate/scale/alpha/recolor/uv-translate/uv-rotate/uv-scale) it reads a bitmask byte (`i_6_`) selecting which of up to three 'smart'-encoded short components are explicitly present (else defaults to 128 for scale-like types 3/10), left-shifts those components for rotate-like types 2/9 (`shl 2 and 0x3fff`, converting to the SpotAnimVector table's angle unit), and packs a small 0-3 value from `i_6_ ushr 3 and 0x3` into a parallel byte array (aByteArray132/136 - exact meaning of these 2 bits not confidently identified). It also tracks the most recent avg-centroid (type 0) label index (i_2_) and, for translate/rotate/scale labels (type 1/2/3), records that centroid label as a 'pivot' reference (aShortArray128/138) whenever it was defined after the last non-trivial label - this lines up with AbstractModel's NA()/resetGroupPivot and the running pivot accumulator fields used by its rotate case (method605 case 2). Results are copied out of five companion-shared size-500 scratch arrays (aShortArray127/133/138/141/142, aByteArray136) into this instance's right-sized arrays; those scratch arrays are freed later by the companion's method177(). Confirmed consumer: AbstractModel.method602 (blendBoneTransforms) iterates aShortArray130 (label ids) and reads aShortArray128 (pivot/‑1) per entry; TextureMaterialGroup.kt builds one NpcModelTransform per group entry from a Js5Archive-loaded byte array. Any exception during parsing is swallowed and the instance is left effectively empty (anInt126=0, aBoolean139/131=false) - a lenient 'skip malformed frame' fallback.

Companion/static. Sets the five shared size-500 scratch arrays (aShortArray127/133/138/141/142, aByteArray136) used only inside the primary constructor's parsing loop to null, presumably to release memory once bulk frame/model loading is done. Single call site is Client.kt:919, sitting in a long sequence of unrelated one-off static setup/cleanup calls made once during client startup - consistent with a 'free temporary parse buffers' cleanup rather than a per-frame reset (no per-frame re-initializer other than the `init { aShortArray141 = ShortArray(500) }` companion block, which only runs once at class-load time, so calling this after startup would in fact break any later NpcModelTransform construction - not verified as intentional, just observed).
